assessment: The article presents a thorough analysis of specific neuronal lineages in the early larval ventral nervous system that relates the birth order to circuit connectivity and function. The key findings of the work are (1) the identification of sharp temporal cohort divisions for the lineages under investigation, (2) synapse formation between neurons of different lineages and temporal cohorts, and (3) the observation that output neurons in this instance are born prior to input neurons.
